fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?
Today I want to talk about

fullTextZH: 我和一个台湾老伯伯的故事。
fullTextEN: a story about me and an old Taiwanese man.

fullTextZH: 我认识了一个70岁的老伯伯。
fullTextEN: I met a 70-year-old man.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜我们在哪里认识的呢？
fullTextEN: Can you guess where we met?

fullTextZH: 在公园，我们在公园认识的。
fullTextEN: In the park, we met in the park.

fullTextZH: 因为我常常去一个公园散步，
fullTextEN: Because I often go to a park to walk,
there is an old man,
he would come and chat with me.
He asked me: 'How old are you?
How old are your children?'
Is your husband American?'
He would ask me questions,

fullTextZH: 然后他也告诉我他的故事。
fullTextEN: then he would also tell me his stories.
He said when he was young,
when he was 20,
he went to Japan to study at university.

fullTextZH: 在日本，有很多日本女孩子喜欢他，
fullTextEN: In Japan, many Japanese girls liked him,
wanting to marry him.
Because he studied at a university in Japan,
so his Japanese is very good.

fullTextZH: 很多日本人来台湾的时候会请他翻译。
fullTextEN: Many Japanese people ask him to translate when they come to Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 翻译就是把日文变中文、
fullTextEN: Translation is turning Japanese into Chinese,
and Chinese into Japanese.
I think, wow,
he went to Japan to study at a university,
his family must be very wealthy.
I also think he is very impressive,
to be able to work as a Japanese translator.

fullTextZH: 我觉得他的故事很有趣。
fullTextEN: I think his story is very interesting.

fullTextZH: 可是我在公园遇到他两次、
fullTextEN: But I met him twice in the park,
after three or four times,
I discovered a problem.
He came to talk to me,

fullTextZH: 然后他开始说自己的故事，
fullTextEN: then he started telling his story,
and it was the same story.
He went to Japan to study at a university,

fullTextZH: 在日本有很多女孩子喜欢他、
fullTextEN: many girls in Japan liked him,
and wanted to marry him.
His Japanese is very good,

fullTextZH: 所以很多日本人来台湾的时候，
fullTextEN: so when many Japanese people come to Taiwan,
they ask him to translate.
Da da da da da da da...
The same story,
I've heard it many times.
Sometimes I ask him questions,
because I want to hear new stories.

fullTextZH: 可是这个老伯伯说着说着，
fullTextEN: But this old man keeps talking,

fullTextZH: 他又开始说一样的故事。
fullTextEN: he starts telling the same story again.

fullTextZH: 最后一次我看到他的时候，
fullTextEN: The last time I saw him,
I said I was going back to England.
He said, "Oh,

fullTextZH: 从台湾去英国坐飞机要多久呢？”
fullTextEN: how long does it take to fly from Taiwan to England?"

fullTextZH: 然后我们开始聊坐飞机的话题。
fullTextEN: Then we started talking about flying.
I thought to myself, "Great,
we're talking about a new topic!"
We chatted a bit,
then he said, "Ah,
England is so far away,
I don't want to go to the UK.
I like Japan,

fullTextZH: 因为以前我在日本念书，
fullTextEN: because I studied in Japan before,

fullTextZH: 然后很多日本女孩子喜欢我，
fullTextEN: then many Japanese girls liked me,
they all wanted to marry me.
So my Japanese is very good,

fullTextZH: 所以很多日本人请我当翻译。”
fullTextEN: so many Japanese people ask me to be a translator.”

fullTextZH: 你觉得我有什么感觉呢？
fullTextEN: What do you think I feel?
I think: 'Here we go again!'

fullTextZH: 他又开始说一样的故事。
fullTextEN: He started telling the same story again.

fullTextZH: 可是我也觉得他很厉害，
fullTextEN: But I also think he's amazing,

fullTextZH: 因为他总是开始一个新的话题，
fullTextEN: because he always starts a new topic,
then as he talks,
he returns to his own story again.

fullTextZH: 好，这就是我和老伯伯的故事。
fullTextEN: Okay, this is the story of me and the old man.

fullTextZH: 你觉得你可以常常听一样的故事吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think you can often listen to the same story?
If you were me,
next time you see the old man,
would you hide?
Please leave a message and tell me.
See you next time, bye!
